Game Overview

At its heart, Valiant Knight is a arcade game about guide your not-so-wealthy knight through a whimsical quest to win a princess's heart. Collect coins, avoid dangerous spikes, and uncover hidden treasures. Navigate clever obstacles, turning barrels, and unseen traps in this playful adventure. Can you overcome each challenging level to fulfill a romantic destiny?
